connector.name: Macwhisper MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MacWhisper transcription for Claude Desktop. Fully local, no cloud, audio stays on your Mac.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package macwhisper-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the docdyhr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MACWHISPER_ALLOWED_PATHS
env.description: Colon-separated list of directories the server may read audio files from (e.g. ~/Desktop:~/Downloads)

env.name: MACWHISPER_CLI
env.description: Path to the mw binary. Auto-detected from /Applications/MacWhisper.app if omitted.
